From: Grace Holloway <grace.holloway@example.com>
Date: 2026-09-02
I'd like to return the standing desk from order ORD-5583120. It wobbles and I haven't assembled it fully.

From: Customer Care (Priya)
Date: 2026-09-03
Sorry to hear that. As the desk is unused you can return it within 30 days of delivery (delivered 2026-08-28). Once it is back we refund the full 349.00 EUR.

From: Grace Holloway <grace.holloway@example.com>
Date: 2026-09-05
Thanks. The courier can only pick it up on the 30th. Is that a problem?

From: Customer Care (Priya)
Date: 2026-09-05
No problem: I have noted your return request today, so the 30-day window is met even if pickup is later. The refund stays 349.00 EUR.

From: Grace Holloway <grace.holloway@example.com>
Date: 2026-09-30
The desk was picked up this morning.

From: Returns system (no-reply)
Date: 2026-10-06
Your return for ORD-5583120 arrived after the 30-day return window. You are eligible for a 10% goodwill voucher instead of a refund.

From: Grace Holloway <grace.holloway@example.com>
Date: 2026-10-07
This is not what Priya promised me in writing on 5 September. I want the full refund of 349.00 EUR as agreed. Grace Holloway, 14 Elm Grove, Bristol
context_docs: 5. Returns: an unused item can be returned within 30 days of delivery for a full refund, with free return shipping. What counts is the date the customer registered the return request (email, phone or returns portal), not the pickup or arrival date of the parcel. From day 31 to day 60, for an unused item: no refund, but offer a goodwill voucher of 10% of the item price. Used items, and requests after day 60: decline.

10. Written commitments: a remedy that an agent confirmed to the customer in writing is honoured, even when a later automated message or one of the rules above says otherwise. Point out the conflict in the agent note.

9. Legal threats, press or consumer-authority mentions: do not argue, do not admit liability and do not decide the remedy; say the complaint is escalated to the complaints manager, who replies within 5 working days (decision: escalate). This rule takes precedence over rules 1 to 8.

key_facts: The return request was registered on 2026-09-05, inside the 30-day window from delivery on 2026-08-28; the later pickup date does not count.
An agent confirmed a full refund of 349.00 EUR in writing on 2026-09-05.
The automated voucher message of 2026-10-06 is wrong for this case.
The reply confirms the full refund of 349.00 EUR, not a voucher.
The desk counts as unused: it was only partly assembled.
